♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: Today the Moon has moved into Virgo in Chitra, activating your 6th house of work, health habits, and problem-solving. The Sun is also in Virgo in Hasta, so your 6th house is strongly lit. Mars and Jupiter continue in Cancer in your 4th, while Saturn retrogrades in Pisces in your 12th and Rahu–Ketu run through Pisces–Virgo. This creates a powerful axis between service (6th), rest (12th), home (4th) and duty. The emphasis is on organising your life so that effort doesn’t quietly drain your emotional reserves.

💼 Career: The double Virgo activation in your 6th house makes this an excellent day for clearing backlogs, structuring projects, or fixing what’s inefficient in your workflow. You may spot errors or inconsistencies that others miss. Chitra’s influence supports design, restructuring, and technical improvements—anything that makes the system cleaner. Just guard against nit-picking colleagues or being overly critical yourself. A short planning session in the morning can prevent unnecessary stress later.

❤️ Love: Because the 6th and 12th houses are strongly involved, relationship energy leans practical rather than dreamy. You may be prompted to discuss division of chores, time management, or how to support each other’s routines. If partnered, tackling one shared task together—organising a space, planning meals, sorting schedules—can actually feel bonding. If single, you might notice attraction in everyday environments: at work, during errands, or through service-related activities.

💰 Money: Virgo in your 6th favours reviewing the small but regular flows of money—subscriptions, service fees, commuting costs, and tools of trade. Tiny adjustments now can bring more breathing room than dramatic moves. Mars–Jupiter in your 4th may still stimulate spending on home or family; channel this into upgrades that genuinely simplify life, rather than decorative extras that add maintenance.

🧘 Advice: Don’t try to fix everything at once. Choose one routine that clearly drains you and redesign it in a way your future self will thank you for.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Order that protects your energy is not fussy; it’s a quiet act of courage.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Moon has stepped into Virgo in Chitra moving through your 5th house of creativity, children, romance, and self-expression. The Sun in Virgo (Hasta) also energises this 5th house, while Mars–Jupiter continue in Cancer in your 3rd and Saturn retrogrades in Pisces in your 11th. The sky encourages you to take a more skilful, deliberate approach to your talents and pleasures—less drifting, more conscious shaping.

💼 Career: With your 3rd and 5th houses lit, this is a productive day for content creation, presentations, teaching, or any work that demands both skill and flair. Chitra’s architectural quality favours drafting plans, decks, campaigns, or prototypes. You can make a strong impression by pairing your natural steadiness with a sharper, more polished message. Collaborators or friends may expect a lot from you; be selective about which team efforts genuinely showcase your gifts.

❤️ Love: The 5th-house focus makes the heart more playful but also more discriminating. You may suddenly see which dynamics feel nourishing and which feel like you are “performing” love. If partnered, suggest a simple yet intentional date—cooking a new recipe together, working on a shared project, or revisiting an old hobby you once enjoyed as a couple. If single, you’re drawn to people whose competence and attention to detail you respect, not just surface charm.

💰 Money: The 3rd and 5th activations support learning a revenue-enhancing skill or polishing a passion project that could later become an income stream. It’s also a useful day to refine how you present your work—portfolio, bios, pricing structure. Avoid speculative risks taken purely for excitement. Instead, think of investments in skills, tools, or study that deepen the value you bring.

🧘 Advice: Let your standards rise without turning into self-criticism. Ask: “What small refinement would make this feel more like me?” and follow that answer.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your joy becomes magnetic when you take it seriously enough to craft it with care.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: With the Moon in Virgo in Chitra activating your 4th house of home, inner foundations, and emotional base—and the Sun also in Virgo in Hasta there—your roots are under the spotlight. Mars and Jupiter continue in Cancer in your 2nd house of income and self-worth, while Saturn retrogrades in Pisces in your 10th. Today’s sky pushes you to examine whether your environment and habits truly support the ambitions you hold.

💼 Career: Saturn retrograde at the top of your chart invites sober reflection about your public role and responsibilities, while the Virgo 4th-house emphasis asks: “What do I need at home to sustain this?” It’s a good day for behind-the-scenes work: planning schedules with family, setting up a more functional workspace, or clarifying boundaries between professional and private time. Chitra supports reorganising furniture, files, or digital systems to give your mind a clearer base of operations.

❤️ Love: The 4th-house Moon makes you crave genuine emotional safety over excitement. If partnered, topics around living arrangements, family expectations, or future home plans may come up. Approach them practically: focus on what each of you needs to feel settled rather than on who is “right.” If single, you may feel less inclined to chase stimulation; people who feel steady, thoughtful, and respectful of your space become more appealing.

💰 Money: With Mars–Jupiter in your 2nd, financial growth is possible, but it needs discipline. Today is suitable for refining budgets around home and family: groceries, utilities, rent or mortgage, and repairs. Watch impulse spending to soothe stress at home; instead, invest in small upgrades that genuinely improve comfort or efficiency. A financial conversation with a family member could be productive if you stay factual.

🧘 Advice: Tend to your base before chasing the next idea. A calmer home rhythm will give your mind the room it craves to create.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When your inner world is in order, your outer words and choices start landing with far more power.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

🔥 Energy: The Moon has entered Virgo in Chitra, moving through your 3rd house of communication, siblings, skills, and daily movements. The Sun in Virgo (Hasta) also illuminates this 3rd house, while Mars–Jupiter continue in your sign in Cancer and Saturn retrogrades in Pisces in your 9th. Thought, travel, and learning are highly activated; you’re prompted to make your efforts more intentional and your voice more precise.

💼 Career: With your 1st and 3rd houses stimulated, this is a strong day for writing, meetings, interviews, and negotiations. You come across as both engaged and practical when you prepare thoroughly. Chitra adds a constructive quality: draft frameworks, outlines, or systems rather than only talking in concepts. Saturn in the 9th reminds you to fact-check and to align your professional choices with your longer-term ethical or educational goals.

❤️ Love: The 3rd-house emphasis turns your attention to how you speak and listen in close relationships. If partnered, small gestures—a thoughtful message, sharing a useful article, a brief walk together—may carry more meaning than big emotional speeches. Misunderstandings can be cleared if you’re willing to explain instead of assuming the other “should know.” If single, attraction may spark in everyday interactions, especially where shared interests or problem-solving is involved.

💰 Money: Mars–Jupiter in your 1st can make you more willing to take initiative around finances—asking questions, seeking better terms, or exploring additional income avenues. Today’s Virgo 3rd-house tone favours practical research: comparing options, reading fine print, or learning new tools that help you manage money more confidently. Be cautious of rushing into contracts; a second review will catch missing details.

🧘 Advice: Before reacting, take a breath and choose your words like tools, not weapons. Clarity today can repair patterns that have annoyed you for months.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When your speech carries both care and structure, people stop guessing what you mean and start meeting you there.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Virgo in Chitra travels through your 2nd house of finances, food, and self-worth, joining the Sun in Virgo in Hasta there. Mars–Jupiter remain in Cancer in your 12th house, and Saturn retrogrades in Pisces in your 8th, with Rahu–Ketu crossing Pisces–Virgo. The focus is on clarifying what you truly value—materially and emotionally—and cutting subtle drains on your resources.

💼 Career: The 2nd-house focus steers you toward practical questions: compensation, pricing, and how your daily efforts translate into tangible support. This is a good day to re-evaluate what you charge, what you accept, and what you give for free. Chitra’s influence helps you redesign offers, portfolios, or CVs so they better reflect your true worth. Behind the scenes, Mars–Jupiter in the 12th hint that unspoken pressures or hidden work may be sapping energy; consider which tasks could be simplified or delegated.

❤️ Love: With the value-oriented 2nd and depth-oriented 8th activated, you’re more sensitive to whether your commitment and affection are reciprocated in deeds, not just words. If partnered, conversations around shared expenses, contributions to the household, and emotional reliability can move forward if you keep the tone grounded rather than dramatic. If single, you may feel less interested in casual flattery; you’re drawn to people whose actions show consistency and respect.

💰 Money: Today is well-suited for a sober look at your numbers. Track recurring charges, small “leaks,” and obligations that no longer make sense. Saturn in the 8th encourages caution around debt, loans, and shared resources—avoid quick fixes that push problems into the future. Instead, consider setting one clear boundary or restructuring one agreement so that it feels more balanced.

🧘 Advice: Let go of the idea that you must say yes to every request to prove your generosity. Protecting your resources is also a form of warmth.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you treat your time and energy as precious, the world slowly learns to treat them that way too.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

🔥 Energy: The Moon has entered your sign in Chitra, joining the Sun in Virgo in Hasta in your 1st house of self, body, and direction. This is a personally pivotal day in your lunar cycle. Saturn retrogrades in Pisces in your 7th, Mars–Jupiter occupy Cancer in your 11th, and Rahu–Ketu run along the Virgo–Pisces axis. The spotlight is on how you show up as yourself in relationships and communities without shrinking or over-controlling.

💼 Career: With both luminaries in your sign, you’re more visible and influential at work. Chitra brings an architect’s mindset—excellent for re-structuring processes, clarifying roles, and proposing a more efficient way forward. At the same time, Saturn in your 7th reminds you that partnerships and contracts carry serious weight; consider where clear agreements or renegotiations are overdue. Allies in your network (11th house) can be especially helpful today, provided you articulate what support you actually need.

❤️ Love: The Virgo–Pisces nodal and Saturn axis makes relationship themes feel karmically loaded but today’s Moon in your 1st encourages you to start with yourself. If partnered, you may feel a strong urge to refine the relationship—better communication, healthier boundaries, more shared responsibility. Choose one realistic change instead of overwhelming your partner with a list. If single, your discernment is sharp; trust your sense of who respects your time and who simply enjoys your attention.

💰 Money: With your identity and contribution under focus, it’s a good day to link your financial goals to the person you are becoming. Review whether your spending patterns match your current priorities—not last year’s. Mars–Jupiter in the 11th can bring opportunities through friends, groups, or long-term plans; just ensure commitments are sustainable before saying yes.

🧘 Advice: Give yourself permission to adjust the image you’ve been holding of who you “should” be. Small external changes that mirror your inner shifts will feel stabilising.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Refinement is not self-rejection; it’s your way of honouring the person you’re quietly growing into.
libra:
♎ Libra

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Virgo in Chitra moves through your 12th house of rest, release, and the subconscious, while the Sun in Virgo in Hasta also lights this introspective zone. Saturn retrogrades in Pisces in your 6th, and Mars–Jupiter energise Cancer in your 10th. Outwardly, responsibilities may be high, yet inwardly your system craves silence and sorting through what’s accumulated.

💼 Career: With Mars–Jupiter at the top of your chart, ambitions and workload remain strong, but the 12th-house Moon and Sun suggest a need to step back briefly to review your direction. This is a powerful day for strategic retreat: catching up on planning, editing, research, or closing old files rather than taking on flashy new tasks. Saturn in the 6th reminds you to respect the limits of your body and time; overcommitting today could lead to fatigue later.

❤️ Love: The 12th-house emphasis heightens sensitivity, dreams, and unspoken longings. If partnered, you may feel more tender or introspective than usual; quiet closeness—a shared nap, simple touch, or talking in low voices at the end of the day—can feel more nourishing than social events. If single, you might find yourself revisiting past patterns in love; instead of chasing closure externally, write down what you’ve learned and what you choose not to repeat.

💰 Money: This is a good day for hidden financial housekeeping: reviewing dormant subscriptions, checking for unnoticed fees, or quietly planning how to reduce any lingering debts (Saturn in the 6th). Avoid impulsive status-oriented purchases tied to work image; focus instead on expenses that truly make your daily grind smoother or protect your rest.

🧘 Advice: Allow yourself pockets of genuine solitude, even if brief. Let thoughts rise and fall without immediately turning them into tasks.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Sometimes the most productive move is to step back far enough to see which efforts actually deserve your grace.
scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Virgo in Chitra activates your 11th house of networks, aspirations, and gains, alongside the Sun in Virgo in Hasta. Mars–Jupiter continue in Cancer in your 9th, Saturn retrogrades in Pisces in your 5th, and Rahu–Ketu run through Pisces–Virgo. Big-picture questions about where you’re headed—and with whom—take precedence.

💼 Career: This is a strong day for strategic networking and aligning your work with your longer-term vision. Chitra’s constructive edge helps you build or refine supportive structures: professional groups, online platforms, or collaborative frameworks. Rather than just collecting contacts, focus on 2–3 relationships that genuinely resonate with your purpose (9th house) and creativity (5th house). You may be asked to take on more visible roles in a group; choose ones that align with your authentic direction, not just prestige.

❤️ Love: The 5th and 11th houses engaged together can blur lines between friendship, romance, and community. If partnered, shared goals—travel, study, creative projects—can re-energise your bond. Talk about where you both want to grow in the next couple of years, not just the next weekend. If single, pay attention to connections that emerge through community spaces, learning circles, or activism; someone who shares your ideals could stand out.

💰 Money: The 11th house is linked to gains from career and from allies. Today favours reviewing whether your current groups and associations are actually opening doors, or just consuming time and resources. You may identify one network that deserves more effort and another that’s ready for a graceful exit. Be measured about lending or mixing money and friends; clear terms protect relationships.

🧘 Advice: Let vision lead logistics. Once you’re clear on what kind of life you’re building, you’ll know instantly which invitations are worth your intensity.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The right circles don’t just include you—they amplify the part of you that knows exactly why you’re here.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Virgo in Chitra reaches your 10th house of career, visibility, and responsibility, joining the Sun in Virgo in Hasta there. Mars–Jupiter in Cancer continue to activate your 8th house of shared resources and deep change, while Saturn retrogrades in Pisces in your 4th. Today’s sky pulls your attention to concrete decisions about direction, reputation, and how stable your inner base feels as you step up.

💼 Career: This is a high-focus day for professional matters. The Virgo emphasis in your 10th urges you to clarify expectations, refine your public profile, and tighten up systems. Chitra helps you “design” your path: structuring proposals, setting realistic milestones, and addressing weak spots in current projects. With Mars–Jupiter in the 8th, joint ventures or behind-the-scenes alliances can be potent—just scrutinise power balances and commitments before you deepen them.

❤️ Love: With so much energy at the top of your chart, relationships might intersect strongly with career realities. If partnered, discussions about balancing home (4th) and work demands are timely. You may need to renegotiate who handles which domestic responsibilities so your ambitions don’t erode your sense of home. If single, attraction is likely around professional environments or shared missions; look for people who respect your calling, not those threatened by it.

💰 Money: The 8th and 10th house activation highlights shared finances, taxes, insurance, or long-term security plans linked to your work life. It’s a good day to ask professional questions about benefits, contracts, or revenue-sharing. You may spot ways to restructure obligations in a more sustainable way. Avoid grand financial gestures to “prove” your commitment; steady, transparent arrangements will serve you better.

🧘 Advice: Stand tall in what you are building, but keep one hand on the foundations of your life. Success that destabilises your inner world isn’t the kind you actually want.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When your ambitions grow from a grounded centre, each step up feels like inhabiting more of yourself—not leaving yourself behind.
capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Virgo in Chitra moves through your 9th house of wisdom, travel, and belief systems, alongside the Sun in Virgo in Hasta. Mars–Jupiter in Cancer light up your 7th house of partnerships, while Saturn—your ruler—retrogrades in Pisces in your 3rd. The emphasis is on rethinking the stories and agreements that shape your life path and close connections.

💼 Career: The 9th-house focus supports activities involving teaching, publishing, legal matters, or expanding into new markets. Chitra’s constructive flavour favours concrete steps: drafting a course outline, reworking a proposal, or planning a trip or training that genuinely advances your expertise. With Mars–Jupiter in your 7th, collaborations can be powerful but also intense; choose partners whose ethics and long-term vision match your own, not just their enthusiasm.

❤️ Love: The 7th and 9th houses together encourage you to look at relationship growth through the lens of shared values and future direction. If partnered, deeper conversations about life philosophy, family traditions, or long-range plans are highlighted. Topics like relocation, study, or spiritual practice together may surface. If single, you may feel drawn to people you meet in learning or travel contexts—someone whose worldview stretches you in a grounded way.

💰 Money: Financially, this is a good time to consider investments in education, certifications, or systems that increase your long-term earning potential. Carefully weigh costs versus the doors they might open. Saturn in the 3rd calls for realistic timelines and solid research before signing up for anything substantial. In partnerships, be explicit about who pays what for shared plans, so goodwill isn’t clouded by unspoken expectations.

🧘 Advice: Let curiosity be structured rather than scattered. One well-chosen area of study or exploration can shift the course of your path more than many half-hearted experiments.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When your commitments and your beliefs finally line up, discipline stops feeling heavy and starts feeling like freedom.
aquarius:
♒ Aquarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Virgo in Chitra moves through your 8th house of shared resources, intimacy, and transformation, joined by the Sun in Virgo in Hasta. Rahu moves through your sign in Aquarius, Ketu through Leo in your 7th, Mars–Jupiter in Cancer activate your 6th, and Saturn retrogrades in Pisces in your 2nd. The tension between independence and interdependence is particularly alive today.

💼 Career: The 6th and 8th houses active together point to collaborations, client agreements, and the practical side of long-term projects. You may need to examine how responsibilities, risks, and rewards are shared. Chitra’s dissecting quality helps you read fine print, clarify terms, and redesign arrangements that feel lopsided. With Rahu in your 1st, you might be tempted to keep shouldering extra work alone; instead, practice delegating or renegotiating in ways that respect both your needs and others’.

❤️ Love: Intimacy themes deepen under an 8th-house Moon. If partnered, conversations may move toward trust, vulnerability, and how you support each other in times of stress—not only when things are smooth. You might discuss shared finances, emotional patterns, or deeper fears. Approach gently, with curiosity rather than interrogation. If single, you could be drawn to intense or enigmatic people; take time to observe how they handle honesty and boundaries before merging lives too quickly.

💰 Money: Saturn in your 2nd encourages sober financial habits, and today’s 8th-house emphasis highlights loans, inheritances, joint accounts, or long-term obligations. It’s a suitable day to consolidate, restructure, or at least fully map out what you owe and what is owed to you. Avoid quick financial entanglements, especially if driven by anxiety or the desire to please.

🧘 Advice: When discomfort rises, don’t immediately distract yourself. Sit long enough to name what you’re actually afraid of losing or exposing.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The trust you most need isn’t blind faith in others—it’s the confidence that you can face the truth and still stay standing.
pisces:
♓ Pisces

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Virgo in Chitra travels through your 7th house of partnerships, joined by the Sun in Virgo in Hasta there. Saturn retrogrades in your sign Pisces in the 1st, Mars–Jupiter in Cancer energise your 5th, and Rahu–Ketu work along the Pisces–Virgo axis. The mirror of relationships is particularly clear today: others’ responses reflect back where you are in your own maturation process.

💼 Career: With the 1st and 7th houses both engaged, client relations, contracts, and one-to-one collaborations are key. The Virgo influence brings a practical tone: roles, expectations, and timelines need specificity. Chitra supports drawing up or updating agreements, proposals, or partnership frameworks. Saturn in your sign may make you more serious or cautious than usual—which can be an asset if it leads to firmer boundaries and more realistic promises.

❤️ Love: The 7th-house Moon heightens awareness of how balanced your connections feel. If partnered, this is a good day to calmly discuss what’s working in your bond and what needs adjustment—without drama or blame. Focus on concrete behaviours rather than vague labels. If single, you may spot patterns in the type of person you attract; use today’s clarity to consciously choose dynamics that respect both your softness and your need for structure.

💰 Money: Financially, attention may go toward shared expenses, couple or household budgets, or business partnerships. Try to keep numbers transparent and simple. Avoid assuming someone else will intuit what you can or cannot manage; Saturn in your 1st supports speaking up clearly about limits and needs. Creative projects (5th house) could hold long-term potential if you treat them with professional seriousness.

🧘 Advice: Don’t disappear into pleasing others. Bring your full, grounded self to the table and let partnership grow from that place, not from sacrifice.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The relationships that truly last are the ones where your sensitivity is met with structure, not taken as permission to over-give.
